# Box Office Mojo

> > Box Office Mojo is the leading source for movie box office revenue tracking, providing comprehensive domestic, international, and worldwide box office data with daily updates, weekend rankings, and annual performance statistics.

Box Office Mojo tracks theatrical revenue performance for films worldwide, offering detailed breakdowns by territory (domestic, international, specific markets like India), time period (daily, weekend, yearly), and release year. The site covers major releases including Avatar: Fire and Ash, Wuthering Heights, Scream 7, and international titles like Boonie Bears and Pegasus 3.

## Key Topics

- Box office revenue tracking
- Domestic vs. international box office splits
- Weekend box office rankings
- Annual box office performance
- 2026 movie releases
- Worldwide box office data
- Film revenue analysis
- Daily box office updates
- Territory-specific box office (India, China, etc.)
- Top-grossing films
- Box office trends and statistics
- Theatrical performance metrics
- Release schedule tracking

## Core Box Office Data

- [Home - Box Office Mojo](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/): Homepage with daily box office tracking and 2026 movie release schedule
- [Domestic Yearly Box Office](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/year/): Annual domestic box office statistics and top-grossing film rankings
- [Worldwide Box Office](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/year/world/): 2026 worldwide box office rankings with domestic/foreign revenue splits

## Weekend Box Office Rankings

- [Domestic Box Office Weekends](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/weekend/): 2026 domestic weekend box office data and film revenue rankings
- [Indian Box Office Weekends](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/weekend/by-year/?area=IN): India-specific weekend box office data and 2026 film revenue tracking
